description: This file defines an API client module for a JavaScript frontend, providing methods for making authenticated HTTP requests to various backend API endpoints, including user listing, session tracking, deployments, costs, and health checks. It contains utility functions for URL and query parameter building, response parsing, and endpoint-specific request handling.

methods.name: getApiClient
methods.description: Returns a minimal axios-like client object with get/post/put/delete methods that internally use fetch.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a backend health check endpoint call.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Fetches a list of users, ignoring extra query parameters except 'organization_id'.

methods.name: listSessions
methods.description: Fetches session tracking data, enforcing tenant_id there.

methods.name: getTenantUsersSummaryStrict
methods.description: Fetches tenant user summary, forcing only 'organization_id' in query.
